units: <cite ref="Keritot 6a:77">Ker. 6ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 26a:4">Pes. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ מראה וריח וכ׳</he> the enjoyment of sound, sight or smell does not come under the category of misuse of sacred property (<cite ref="M02111"><he>מְעַילָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Zevachim 88b:6">Zeb. 88ᵇ</cite> <he>יבא דבר שבק׳ ויכפר על ק׳ הרע</he> let that which is accompanied by sound (the high priest’s robe) bring atonement for evil sound (evil talk).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:8">Gen. R. s. 17</cite> <he>קוֹלָהּ הולך</he> woman’s voice is penetrating.
<cite ref="Pesachim 56a:5">Pes. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>בק׳ רם</he> in a loud voice, opp. <he>בחשאי</he>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 16a:14">Keth. 16ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>יש לה ק׳</he> is spoken about, is known among people; a. v. fr.—<he>בת ק׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B01377"><he>בַּת</he> I</cite>.—Pl. <he>קוֹלוֹת</he>, constr. <he>קוֹלֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5:23">Ex. R. s. 5</cite> <he>הקול יוצא ונחלק לשבעים ק׳ וכ׳</he> the voice (of revelation) went forth and was divided into seventy voices corresponding to seventy languages.
<cite ref="Berakhot 15b:22">Ber. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>בקולי ק׳</he> under loud cries; a. fr.—[<he>קול מזמסיא</he>, v. <cite ref="M00747"><he>מַזְיָא</he></cite>.]
